hero.structure: Image covering full viewport with fixed attachment. Gradient overlay 'bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/50 to-transparent'. Massive H1 heading left aligned.
hero.cta_pills: 5 elegant pill buttons representing categories. Flex-wrap or horizontal scroll. Glassmorphic background 'bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md', 1px gold border 'border-primary/30'. Must smooth-scroll directly to corresponding category section ID.

category_section.structure: Large background numbering (e.g., '01') in extremely large faint text 'text-[15vw] text-white/5 font-serif absolute'. One prominent lifestyle image corresponding to the category alongside a bento grid of curated product cards.

product_card.style: Premium landing page feel. 'bg-[#141311] border border-[#D4AF37]/20'. Soft gold glow on hover 'hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)] transition-all duration-500'. Image top, content bottom. Primary gold CTA button.

product_landing_page.structure: Split screen hero with sticky product image on one side, scrolling details on the other. High-contrast typography. Sections: The Benefit, Testimonial/Video, FAQ Accordion, Sticky Add-to-Cart at bottom.

testimonial.style: Massive serif quotation marks. Grid of minimal cards with user avatars. Quote in 'text-primary' high contrast, author in muted gold.

faq.style: Minimalist accordion. No background per item. Bottom borders only 'border-b border-[#D4AF37]/20'. Elegant plus/minus toggle icons.

footer.style: Expansive spacing 'py-32'. Massive serif brand slogan at top. 4-column link structure. Clean single-line newsletter input with bottom border only.

admin_dashboard.style: Swiss-inspired dark mode. Dense bento grid stats. Sidebar nav. Focus on CRUD logic clarity. Uses same dark/gold palette but less dramatic lighting (flatter surfaces for readability).

motion_guidelines.hover: Smooth transform-gpu duration-500 ease-out. Slight scale up (1.02) and subtle gold box-shadow glow.
motion_guidelines.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling. Fade-in and translate-up on scroll.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard Tailwind CSS classes mapping to the color variables in this file.
MUST use 'Cormorant Garamond' for headings and 'Outfit' for body text. Add these via Google Fonts (or similar) in your layout setup.
Do not use generic UI cards. Implement the specific glassmorphism and subtle gold borders (1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2)) to preserve the luxury vibe.
Ensure all interactive and informational elements have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based) for testing.
The project uses .js/.jsx files (not TypeScript/tsx). Apply these guidelines to standard React Javascript files.
Ensure hero section category CTA pills navigate cleanly to their corresponding distinct sections via smooth scrolling anchor links.
Products must have detailed landing pages (value props, FAQ, benefits) rather than generic simple ecommerce cards when clicked.
Admin dashboard must be a fully functional dark-mode UI focused on CRUD for products, subscribers, and messages.
